title: hordeum maritimum subsp. hystrix
intro: Hordeum maritimum subsp. hystrix, commonly known as Beach Spelt, is a plant species in the Poaceae family, which is native to the Mediterranean region. The plant has been found to have various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help protect against oxidative stress, inflammation, and infection. The therapeutic actions of Hordeum maritimum subsp. hystrix include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which can contribute to its potential use in the prevention and treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and lignans, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may play a role in its potential health benefits.
